description: Test file for Vitest configuration and utility functions related to parallel test execution and system load management.

methods.name: resolveDefaultVitestPool
methods.description: Returns the default pool type for Vitest (usually 'threads').

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of Vitest workers based on system specs and overrides.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Decides test scheduling parameters considering system load and current Vitest activity.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Parses a list of process info strings to count active Vitest root and worker processes and their CPU usage.
